author: Inside Edition
description: A Milwaukee police officer shot and killed a man when officials say the suspect kept driving a flatbed truck despite the officer holding on and telling him to stop. A patrol car followed the truck as it wove through the city's streets. Bodycam video shows the officer hanging onto the fleeing truck, pulling out his service weapon and giving warnings to the driver to stop as a passenger also begged him to stop. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cop Clings To Fleeing Vehicle, Fatally Shoots Suspect Who Refuses To Stop

author: Inside Edition
description: Reporters from around the globe have descended on the Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral in Florida. Inside Edition spoke with ABC News transportation correspondent Gio Benitez and Fox Weather correspondent Brandy Campbell. In 2023, Inside Edition spoke to Artemis II astronauts Reid Wiseman, Christina Kock, Victor Glover and Jeremy Hansen in Times Square when the mission was announced.
title: Vid Published: 4 Astronauts To Launch To Moon In Historic Mission

author: Inside Edition
description: The son of the doctor accused of trying to throw his wife off a cliff in Hawaii took to the stand as a witness against his father, Gerhardt Konig. Emile Konig says his father admitted trying to kill Arielle Konig. Gerhardt and Arielle were on a hike on a trail in Hawaii when he allegedly hit Arielle with a rock so he could push her over the cliff. Arielle escaped. Gerhardt has pleaded not guilty to attempted murder. He is claiming self-defense saying his wife attacked him first.
title: Son Of Doctor Accused Of Trying To Kill Wife Testifies In Court

author: Inside Edition
description: In Fairview Park, Ohio in 1972, Darlene Gilleland and Rita Marshall spotted an abandoned infant, just a few hours old, wrapped in a paper bag. The women accompanied the 7-pound baby girl to the hospital before she was eventually placed for adoption. That baby from 53 years ago is Pearl Marshall. She reached out to researcher Chris Gerrett, who tracked down Darlene and Rita. Pearl, Darlene and Rita reunited and could not help but reminisce.
title: Abandoned Baby In 1972 Reunites With Women Who Found Her
